coverage: Tested · Historical Opyn Crab isolated liquidity scenario

Actual ETH deposit and Crab mint, later sufficient-sized observed oSQTH sale, and bounded payout from 31 shutdown redemptions. Single historical lot with pro-rata hedge proceeds and modeled redemption gas.

results.group: Opyn Crab V2 · dated mint, hedge and shutdown scenario
results.archive_interval: Mainnet deposit, swap and redemption events

method: The observed deposit mints strategy shares and oSQTH. The study disposes of the contemporaneous oSQTH allocation through the first later observed sufficiently sized pool sale. The mint and hedge are separate events, with exposure remaining during that delay. Funds are settled at a conservative rate from actual shutdown redemptions. The observed sale price already embeds the venue fee and price impact. Gross adds back the nominal pool fee and the net scenario charges recorded available gas and the historical median redemption gas. All quotes are ETH, and drawdown uses realized settlement on the observed entry notional.
